Title: Release of Service Fabric SDK 2.6.220 and Runtime 5.6.220 refresh for Windows

Body.Content:
Version 2.6.220 of the Azure Service Fabric SDK is now available, along with version 5.6.220 of the Service Fabric Runtime that rolled out to Azure clusters worldwide. Service Fabric 5.6.220 Standalone for Windows Server is also available for download.

Please see the Service Fabric team blog for more information about the runtime and SDK updates and the Standalone for Windows Server update.
